evd_title: LLMs demonstrated systematic reasoning errors in QUADAS-2 patient selection domain including misinterpreting consecutive sampling and case-control design
finding: LLMs demonstrated systematic reasoning errors in QUADAS-2 patient selection domain including misinterpreting consecutive sampling and case-control design
P: 10 diagnostic-accuracy articles (diabetes, PubMed), QUADAS-2 patient-selection domain (120 assessments)
I: ChatGPT 4o, Grok 3, Gemini 2.0 Flash, DeepSeek V3; zero-shot via web UI, PDF upload, new session per article
O: Qualitative error themes (consecutive sampling, case-control, exclusions); patient-selection correct 65.83% (Gemini 50%, GPT-4o 76.67%)
S: Qualitative reasoning-error analysis within cross-sectional benchmark
T: PubMed search 9 May 2025 (most recent articles); paper 2025
